artworks.title: Un Jour de grande revue
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full body view, both positioned as if marching. The person on the left is larger, has a prominent chin, furrowed brows, and a serious expression. Their hair is short and light. They wear a military-style uniform with a hat, a white cross belt, and boots, carrying a rifle on their shoulder. The figure on the right is smaller, wears a similar military-style uniform with a hat and a sword, and marches alongside the larger figure. In the background, there is a sketched interior scene with large, indistinct shapes suggesting walls, and a ground paved with cobblestones.

artworks.title: Comment on donne... le goût de la navigation
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: a child and an adult. The child is standing with their entire body visible from head to toe, dressed in a simple, loose-fitting long garment. The child has short hair and stands with hands clasped behind the back, facing the adult. The adult is shown kneeling on the floor with their weight supported by one knee and leaning closely toward a bowl of water on the floor, where a small paper boat is floating. The adult has disheveled hair and a slightly exaggerated facial expression. The adult is wearing what appears to be a long coat. Around them, there is a jug placed on the floor beside the bowl, and in the background, there is a tall cupboard or piece of furniture with a jug, another object, and a platter or plate on top. The scene is shaded to indicate an indoor setting with a textured background and a partially visible door or partition.

artworks.title: Allons, papa... encore... trente-deux tours!...
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in full body view. There is a man jumping rope in the center, one child holding one end of the rope on the left, and another child holding the other end on the right. The man has a beard, mustache, and glasses, and is wearing a suit. The child on the left wears a dark jacket and light trousers, facing the man. The child on the right wears a dress and has hair tied back. In the background, there is a simple interior setting with a picture frame hanging on the wall. The floor displays a scrawled diagram.

artworks.title: Voyez donc un peu, Isménie!...
artworks.description: Two women stand side by side, engaged in conversation. The woman on the left is in a gown with a shawl and long hair covered; the woman on the right is pointing to a poster on the wall. The background shows framed pictures and a large poster reading "LES BAS BLEUS. 40 CARICATURES, PAR DAUMIER. (Série complète.) PRIX: 20 FRANCS." Below the scene, there is a caption in French.

artworks.title: La Présidente criant a tue-tête: Mesdames!...
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group of people gathered together. In the foreground, there is a central figure that seems to be in a position of authority. They are holding a bell and gesturing to their ear. The figure is dressed in intricate historical clothing. Surrounding the central figure, a large group of individuals are engaged in conversation or debate. The style of the drawing utilizes heavy lines and contrasting shades, reminiscent of 19th-century caricature art.

artworks.title: Nous voila... réunies pour écrire le premier numéro...
artworks.description: Three women are shown around a table engaged in various activities. The woman on the left is sitting sideways on a chair holding a piece of paper and a pen. The woman in the middle is writing intently. The woman on the right is standing with an object balanced on her nose, looking upwards. The setting is indoors with a lamp in the background.

artworks.title: O Lune!... inspire-moi ce soir quelque petite pensée...
artworks.description: The image portrays a person sitting in an armchair facing a window. The person is leaned back slightly, looking out of the window. Their facial features are not clearly visible due to the profile angle. The person is wearing nightclothes and the chair is ornate. A book is placed nearby. Outside the window, there is a cityscape with several buildings under the light of a full moon.

artworks.title: Dis donc, Bichette... a quoi songes-tu donc...
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a dimly lit bedroom. A woman on the right side is standing, holding a candle, while a person on the left side is lying in bed.

artworks.title: Au revoir, Ophélia!... ne manquez pas...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaging in a conversation at the base of a staircase. The scene features a woman leaning over the railing of a staircase, conversing with another woman standing below. The woman on the staircase is wearing a long dress, and the other woman is dressed warmly, complete with a bonnet and a shawl. The drawing has a sketch-like quality, with lines that add depth and dimension to the figures and the setting. The text and style suggest a humorous or critical tone.

artworks.title: Le Bas-bleu déclamant sa pièce
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in front of three seated figures. She appears expressive, holding a document and wearing a mid-19th-century style dress. The seated figures include an older man, a man with a bald head, and a woman in the background. The setting seems to be indoors with framed artwork on the wall.

artworks.title: L'Artiste m'a représentée au moment ou j'écris
artworks.description: The image features two individuals standing in front of a framed painting. On the left, a woman with long curly hair is slightly turned towards the painting. She wears a long-sleeved dress. On the right, a man faces the painting with his back to the viewer, wearing a dark jacket or coat. Both individuals are focused on the painting depicting a person holding a quill and surrounded by elaborate drapery. The ornate frame of the painting is detailed, and the background indicates an indoor setting.

artworks.title: ...dussent-ils me maudire. Ces barbares parens...
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing on a platform in an elegant gown, facing left. Four seated older individuals are attentively listening to her. The room is decorated with large framed artworks and has a refined interior.

artworks.title: Un Bouquiniste dans l'ivresse
artworks.description: The image shows two upper-body portraits of men positioned side by side. The man on the left is facing slightly to the right, holding a small book open in his hands, with his head turned towards the book. He has short hair and a defined nose, with distinct eyebrows. The man on the right leans slightly towards the first man, looking at the book. He has thinning, wavy hair, a slightly pronounced nose, and appears elderly. Both wear similar high-collared garments, and the man on the left has a rolled-up paper tucked into his garment. The background features a pattern of shaded lines, creating a halo effect around the figures, with additional text above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Les Voisines devant le Juge de paix
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a courtroom setting. Two elderly figures on the left engage in discussion while a stern figure at a high desk wears formal attire suggesting a position of authority, likely in a judicial role. The background is indistinct, focusing attention on the three figures and their interaction. The drawing style features fine lines and shading reminiscent of French caricature art from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Le Retour de la foire de Saint-Cloud
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a man and several other figures around him, captured mostly from the waist up. The man is standing in the center with his arms raised to cover his ears. He has a startled facial expression with wide eyes and an open mouth. He wears a tall, black top hat and a dark coat. Other figures around him are playing musical instruments. There is a woman and children playing, with some depicted in profile wearing bonnets or hats and holding pipes or flutes. Two other children on the left are also playing similar instruments and wearing hats. The background includes additional figures and a textured backdrop suggesting a crowd or commotion, with a text header reading "Les Beaux Jours de la Vie" and additional text below the illustration.

artworks.title: Un Diner chez Véry
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, focused on their upper bodies. The person on the left stands facing forward, holding a cane under his left arm. He has a stern expression, curly hair, and wears a top hat, overcoat, and high collar with a scarf or tie tucked under his chin. His hands are crossed near his waist. Beside him is a shorter figure holding a tray. The background has indistinct text and illustrations, and the foreground includes a caption related to the setting's theme.

artworks.title: Une Rencontre agréable
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a cartoon or caricature style illustration. The man on the left has a long, pointy nose and prominent chin, wearing a tall, wide-brimmed hat and a dark coat. The man on the right has a more rounded facial structure, small eyes, and sideburns, wearing a tall, narrow-brimmed hat and a buttoned coat with a high collar. Both figures have exaggerated facial features typical of caricatures. Text is present at the top and bottom of the image, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Fusion des compagnies
artworks.description: This image depicts an illustration of two men embracing. The man on the left wears a tall top hat and holds a document labeled "Societe Compagnie Tartampion," while the man on the right holds a document labeled “Compagnie Lanchélur.” Both men are in formal attire with suits. The background is a simple textured shading. French text is visible along the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Un Premier voyage en chemin de fer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of passengers seated inside a train carriage. The drawing portrays a group of individuals sitting closely together on a bench inside the train carriage. The figures are drawn with exaggerated features. The space is closely confined, highlighting the cramped conditions typically experienced in early rail travel. The figures are dressed in formal attire of the period. Their expressions range from curiosity to introspection. The subtle use of shading and linework contributes to the drawing's overall tone, focusing on the dynamics and discomfort of travel.

artworks.title: L'honneur d'être parrain
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals visible from the waist up. The man on the left is standing upright with a slightly turned head, looking towards his left. He has a distinct facial expression with wide eyes and a pronounced frown, and his hair curls around his ears from under a tall, black top hat. He is dressed in a dark coat and a white shirt underneath, and he is holding large, cylindrical boxes in both hands. Next to him and slightly behind, the woman looks towards him with her head slightly angled. She has a round face with discernible eyebrows and small lips, wearing her hair pinned up with a white bonnet framing her face. She wears a dress with a high neckline and ruffled collar. She also holds a cylindrical box in her arms. In the background, there are shelves filled with more stacked, cylindrical boxes, suggesting that they are in a store or shop setting.

artworks.title: Une Réparation d'honneur
artworks.description: The image shows four men from the waist up. They are positioned in a group, engaging with one another; two men in the foreground are shaking hands, while two others stand closely observing. All four men wear top hats. The man on the right has an elaborate mustache, and his hair is tucked under his hat. He is wearing a light-colored coat and a dark bow tie. The man on the left who is shaking hands with him has a beard and sideburns, wearing a dark suit with some patterning. The two men in the background have their attention focused on the handshake with neutral expressions, and they too wear dark suits and bow ties. The setting is unclear but suggests an indoor environment.

artworks.title: Un Prix de poésie
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in a satirical illustration style. The person on the left has an elongated facial profile with a prominent nose, wavy hair, and is placing a laurel wreath on the head of the person on the right. The person on the right is shown from the waist up, with a pronounced chin and closed eyes. They are receiving the laurel wreath and holding their chest. Both individuals are dressed in dark suits. The background has a textured pattern with text above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Une Promotion
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is wearing a large chef's hat, a neck scarf, and a buttoned chef's coat. Their facial features are somewhat sharp, with a distinct nose and a focused expression. To their left is another person, wearing a headscarf and similar attire. This person's facial features are more pronounced, with a prominent nose and visible laugh lines. On the countertop, there are ingredients like a large piece of meat and vegetables, and the person on the left holds a round object in their hands. In the background, kitchen tools such as a pan and a pot hang on the wall. The scene appears to be set in a kitchen or culinary workspace with a simple tiled pattern on the walls behind them.

artworks.title: Un Habit a la mode
artworks.description: Two men are depicted waist up, facing right. The man on the left has curly balding hair, a prominent nose, and wears a dark coat. His hands are behind his back, holding a limp cloth. The man on the right wears small round glasses, with neatly combed-back hair. He has a stern or pensive expression and wears a dark jacket with large lapels. The background is shaded with cross-hatched patterns, and there is French text related to fashion at the bottom.
